description: Router prompt tuning history for the local LLM (Phase 6). DEV SET ONLY (eval/agent_cases.json, 83 non-scripted cases, placeholders replaced by fixed synthetic stand-ins, route-only scoring directly against Ollama). These are TUNED numbers, not generalization; held-out v1/v2 and the adversarial set were never used for tuning (v2/adversarial were committed in 586aca0 before tuning began).

iterations.prompt: v0 (Phase 5 prompt, catalog = names + argument names)
iterations.note: model put a tool on non-TOOL routes; confidence 100

iterations.prompt: v1 (route definitions, field rules, argument types)
v2 (v1 + 12 worked examples written fresh, not from any dataset)

stopped_because: Three iterations moved errors between routes instead of removing them; ceiling of this 0.5B model judged ~40% route accuracy. Stopped to avoid overfitting the dev set.
